patterns: APPSC asks simple definitional/person recall: father of geography (Eratosthenes), first to divide circle into 360 deg (Hipparchus), latitudes run east-west.

Other PSCs heavily test which countries the Equator / Prime Meridian / Tropics cross (Kenya yes, Mexico no), 0 deg-0 deg in Atlantic (Gulf of Guinea), 180 deg meridian forms a great circle with Prime Meridian.
India extremes are a staple: Indira Point (Great Nicobar) southernmost, Arunachal-Gujarat east-west, 68 deg 7' E westernmost.

App MCQs match PYQ shapes well and add AP location facts (latitudinal extent, neighbours, districts, IST meridian) that suit APPSC's AP tilt; some items (Equal Earth UNGA vote, EOS-05) are current-affairs add-ons.
